objective: Bundle ripgrep and fd in the holyagent plugin for darwin-arm64, linux-x64 and windows-x64, expose them through the holyagent CLI, and make every holyagent agent use them for content and file search.
scope: User decision: drop fff; bundle rg and fd; agents must use them.

Known (research, verify versions and checksums now): ripgrep 15.2.0 assets ripgrep-15.2.0-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz, -x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz, -x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip; fd v10.5.0 assets fd-v10.5.0-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz, -x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz (or gnu), -x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip. claude.ai rejects plugins with a top-level bin/, so ship them under scripts/ (for example dist/scripts/vendor/<target>/rg[.exe]); build.ts chmods files flagged executable and git keeps mode 100755. Keep each license file (rg: MIT/Unlicense, fd: MIT/Apache-2.0) beside the binaries.

Design: a pinned version and SHA-256 per asset in source; a build step (a Bun script run by mise, e.g. a vendor task) downloads, verifies and extracts them into the plugin output; `holyagent rg ...` and `holyagent fd ...` run the binary for the current platform with inherited stdio and exit code. Agents: specialists and the root that have Bash use `holyagent rg`/`holyagent fd` instead of grep, find or the built-in Grep/Glob; roles without Bash keep the built-in Grep and Glob (state in the report whether those are ripgrep-backed). Put the rule in the instruction source (packages/runtime/src/instructions: requirements.md first, then the claude-5.5 root and specialist sections) and adjust agent tool lists in packages/integrations/claude/src/agents.ts only if needed.
Report the total size added to dist and per binary.
constraints: Follow /home/user/holyagent/.claude/CLAUDE.md (Effect with tagged errors, no try/catch/new Promise/async in runtime source, Schema at boundaries, Bun APIs and Bun Shell, JSDoc on exports) and AGENTS.md.
Work only in your worktree; make no version-control writes (no commit, add, checkout, switch, merge, stash, push) and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/.

Run `bun install --frozen-lockfile` in your worktree first if node_modules is missing (mise is installed; run gates through mise). When done, run `mise run build` and `mise run verify` in your worktree and report the results.

Keep working until everything asked is done; stop to ask only when you cannot go on or before a risky step. When done and checked, stop and report; do not add unrequested features or refactors (name them in the report).

criteria.text: holyagent rg and holyagent fd run the bundled binary for each of the three targets, with checksums verified at build time and licenses shipped
Instruction text tells every agent with Bash to search with them, and roles without Bash have a stated rule
Tests cover target selection, a missing binary error and the CLI pass-through
The plugin keeps no top-level bin/ and mise run verify passes in the worktree
